title: Roofing: licensed-trade identity with business-contact contrast
hypothesis: An active, roofing-scoped contractor register can establish a named principal or qualifying-person candidate, but neither its published phone nor a Maps number is owner-confirmed until exclusivity, contrast, contact gates, and independent owner evidence support that classification.
ownerSource: State contractor records: WA L&I primary principal for roofing specialties, CA CSLB C-39 personnel with title distinctions, FL DBPR roofing qualifiers, and IL roofing qualifying parties. Each is a candidate source whose legal and role constraints vary by state.
phoneSource: A register phone where the source publishes one, contrasted with the Maps business number. It remains a business or candidate contact until mobile, live, DNC, suppression/dedupe, and owner-evidence gates pass.

workflow.label: State legal gate
workflow.detail: Allow only a legally eligible register route; prohibited states use the permitted fallback policy.

workflow.label: Maps business-contact fallback
workflow.detail: Use core roofing discovery only where the state register route is unavailable but Maps fallback is permitted.

workflow.label: Hold restricted source
workflow.detail: Do not ingest or use a prohibited commercial-list source.

workflow.label: Active roofing register
workflow.detail: Require an active roofing class or specialty such as WA ROOF, CA C-39, or an explicit FL roofing class.

workflow.label: Ownership-role assessment
workflow.detail: Sole Owner, partner, member, or individual registrant is stronger evidence; qualifier, RMO, and RME require different treatment.

workflow.label: Hold insufficient role
workflow.detail: RME and unsupported qualifier/large-operator roles cannot be delivered as owner contacts.

workflow.label: Maps contrast and roofing fit
workflow.detail: Match an active core-roofing listing; reject adjacent-only, unrelated contractor, brand, and stale matches.

workflow.label: Exclusive register phone?
workflow.detail: A phone shared across businesses or missing from the register is not a direct candidate; a different Maps phone is contrast evidence only.

workflow.label: Hold non-exclusive or absent phone
workflow.detail: Do not infer a private number or label a business line as a direct owner contact.

workflow.label: Contact and suppression gates
workflow.detail: Apply mobile line type, live status, DNC, global dedupe, and required owner-evidence checks.

workflow.label: Hold failed contact
workflow.detail: Park office, non-mobile, unreachable, suppressed, or unsupported-owner cases.

workflow.label: Deliver supported classification
workflow.detail: Deliver only after all required gates pass; owner-confirmed mobile needs independent owner evidence.

edges.label: all gates and owner evidence pass

failures.risk: Maps-first roofing begins with an advertised office line rather than owner identity.
failures.mitigation: Use a legally eligible, trade-scoped register as identity source and Maps as contrast/activity evidence.

failures.risk: A WA source filter cannot select roofing because the adapter persists only entity type in business_type.
failures.mitigation: Persist normalized specialty/class data usable by the jobs filter, or make the adapter specialty-scoped.

failures.risk: Qualifier, RMO, or RME is represented as company owner.
failures.mitigation: Preserve role codes; reject RME and require independent owner evidence for unsupported qualifier/RMO cases.

failures.risk: Gutters, siding, restoration, general contracting, or a roofing franchise enters the independent-roofer route.
failures.mitigation: Require class/specialty or core roofing relevance; apply brand, phone reuse, size, and activity filters.

failures.risk: A register business phone is called a direct owner mobile.
failures.mitigation: Require phone exclusivity, Maps contrast, mobile/live/DNC/dedupe gates, and independent owner evidence.

iterations.hypothesis: The Maps-first roofing profile could serve as the owner-contact starting point.
iterations.test: Free aggregate-only WA L&I query of 20 active rows whose first specialty contained ROOF on 2026-09-24.
iterations.observed: 20/20 had primaryprincipalname and phonenumber; only 1/20 had Individual business type. The sample establishes field coverage, not owner or handset ownership.
iterations.change: Treat the register as trade/identity and contact-candidate evidence, introduce role and exclusivity branches, and do not label a register or Maps phone owner-confirmed without independent evidence.

measurement.result: WA L&I m8qx-ubtq active rows with specialtycode1desc containing ROOF: 20/20 active, 20/20 specialty present, 20/20 primaryprincipalname present, 20/20 phonenumber present, and 1/20 Individual business type. Aggregate-only observation; no contact values retained. It does not measure mobile status, reachability, DNC, handset ownership, owner confirmation, or delivery.

cost.note: No clean delivered owner contact was measured. Historical roofing brain rates and the Miami Maps observation use different denominators and are not a per-clean cost for this workflow.

implementation.summary: WA, CA, and FL contractor adapters exist, and roofing relevance is recognized, but roofing itself remains recipe A with no register mapping. WA trade data is not persisted into the field consumed by source filtering, so a roofing mapping cannot yet select the right register rows.

nextMeasurement: Add synthetic WA roofing and non-roofing rows, then verify a roofing job selects only the trade-scoped row, preserves principal as a candidate role, and cannot deliver an owner label without independent evidence. After authorization, measure mobile, live, DNC-cleared, reached-owner, and delivered outcomes with separate denominators.
